concerns: Annual restoration has lower update frequency than the existing annual+TTM panel. No 2026 interim figures were added.
Vestas FY2021 later comparatives were restated for cloud-computing accounting; this restoration uses FY2021 values as printed in the FY2021 report.

Vendor operating_income often differs materially from statutory EBIT: Orsted FY2023 vendor +12853 versus statutory -17853; Vestas FY2022 vendor -962 versus statutory -1596. Mixing them silently would change the score definition.
For Orsted FY2020, the IFRS column is used, not its alternative business-performance column.

Orsted presents held-for-sale liabilities separately from current liabilities (2020:687; 2021:492; 2025:1871 DKKm). The literal current-liabilities subtotal is used; this should be disclosed as an accounting comparability limitation.
Orsted FY2020 operating-cash-flow line refers to continuing operations while profit includes a discontinued-operation loss of 11 DKKm. No unsupported cash-flow adjustment was made.
These are issuer-hosted historical annual reports retrieved now, with dated release evidence; this is not a certified archive of every original file version.
